name: Henry Lawson
bio: Henry is the publisher of State News Digest, working from Trenton, New Jersey. His background is in media and business operations, and he holds responsibility for the publication’s overall direction, financial sustainability, and the independence of the editorial operation from the commercial side of the site. He leaves the day-to-day editorial decisions to the newsroom and writes an occasional column on the business of journalism.
